text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 6, 2025) for 186 Danforth Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 6, 2025) for 186 Danforth Road, Folder Number 25 204201 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 15, 2026, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
